blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawmakers from Makabayan bloc on Thursday filed a resolution calling for a congressional inquiry into the string of arrests during the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit in Manila. House Resolution No. 1632 was introduced by ACT Teachers Rep. Antonio Tinio, Kabataan Rep. Renee Co and Gabriela Women’s Party Rep. Sarah Elago for this purpose. The investigation seeks to condemn the behavior of the police in arresting hundreds of protestors demonstrating against the arrival of US President Donald Trump. “The PNP committed gross human rights violations against the arrested protestors,” the resolution read.
